name: main
_comment: Applied via `gh api -X PUT repos/Adam-S-Daniel/adamdaniel.ai/rulesets/13985217 --input .github/rulesets/main.json` — checked in here so the rule is reviewable in the repo. Required status checks block merges to main when CI fails. The list intentionally only includes checks that always fire when their workflow fires: `validate-content` (cms-editorial-workflow.yml, no paths filter) and `scan` (secrets-scan.yml, no paths filter) fire on every PR; `select`, `unit`, `parity`, `e2e (1)`, `e2e-admin`, and `finalize` come from e2e-tests.yml which has `paths-ignore` so they may not appear on truly doc-only PRs — when that happens, branch protection blocks the merge as designed; the owner can override or the PR can be expanded with a small site change. `e2e (1)` is shard 1 of the dynamic public matrix (always present per `pickShardCount()` and the `case` block in the workflow); `e2e-admin` is the single-shard admin-lane matrix (chromium-desktop-3k + webkit-iphone16) that always fires when e2e-tests does; `finalize` is the roll-up that re-fails if either matrix failed (`if: !cancelled()`, last step exits 1 on `needs.e2e.result == 'failure' || needs.e2e-admin.result == 'failure'`) — together they give shard-rename resilience plus a single roll-up signal. `prod-mutate` was previously listed but removed because `cms-publish-loop-prod.yml` now uses workflow-level `paths:` (the missing-check trap); `host-loop`, `deploy-preview`, and `approve-regression` are excluded for the same reason. If you add a new required check that uses `paths`/`paths-ignore` filtering, convert it to the always-run + early-skip pattern first (see `cms-publish-loop-prod.yml`'s tear-down for an example of what NOT to do, and the `select` job in `e2e-tests.yml` for the pattern that works). `preview-media` (preview-media.yml) is the first check built on the always-run + early-skip pattern: it fires on every PR with NO `paths` filter, detects media-salient changes in an early step, and reports success immediately otherwise — so the context is always present (no stub needed; it joins the always-fire set with validate-content/scan) and a preview-pr<N> surface that is absent (deploy-preview is path-filtered + non-required) soft-passes with a loud warning rather than blocking the merge.
